comparison.objective: Release a drawout relay handle, withdraw the plug-in unit with two hands, and place it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle release, bimanual extraction, supported transport, and placement.

comparison.reason: This is latch release and module extraction, whereas the candidate tests tool-mediated collar tuning and retained dynamic stopping performance without component removal.
